canonical_project: Zoodlabs Data Centre / ACE Cable Landing Station, Freetown
owner: Zoodlabs (SL) Limited (ACE landing station manager; Sierra Leone Cable Ltd SALCAB agreement)
notes: Zoodlabs manages the ACE submarine cable landing station in Freetown (per MoCTI National Broadband Strategy 2023-2028 and GoSL operational agreement) and operates its 'Zoodlabs Data Centre' there: CrossBoundary Energy (A/B supplier source) powers it with 0.8 MWp solar, 0.7 MW thermal generation and 1.95 MWh storage (commissioned Q2 2023). colo.exchange directory (grade C) lists a 'Zoodlabs CLS MMR' colocation facility on Bendu's Drive, Lumley Beach area, Freetown - public colocation offering unverified by operator first-party pages. Power figures are supply-system ratings, not IT load, so capacity_mw kept null. The CLS/MMR is a landing-station/interconnection asset rather than a standalone commercial DC.
